# Reid Design LLC

> Reid Design LLC is a residential interior design studio in Plainfield, Indiana, run by Staci Perkins. It serves homeowners in Plainfield, Indianapolis, and the surrounding suburbs (Carmel, Fishers, Westfield, Zionsville, Noblesville) with warm, livable, mid-market design. Services run from a $150 in-home consultation up to full room design, styling, shopping and sourcing, and online E-Design. Pricing is shown openly on the site.

## Key pages
- [Services and pricing](https://reiddesignllc.com/services/): Every service tier and what it costs
- [Process](https://reiddesignllc.com/process/): How a project works from first call to final reveal
- [Portfolio](https://reiddesignllc.com/portfolio/): Recent room projects across the Indianapolis suburbs
- [E-Design](https://reiddesignllc.com/e-design/): Online room design delivered digitally, for clients anywhere
- [About](https://reiddesignllc.com/about/): Staci Perkins's story and design philosophy
- [FAQ](https://reiddesignllc.com/faq/): Common questions about working together
- [Contact](https://reiddesignllc.com/contact/): How to book a consultation
